persona: Dev, a bakery owner who has never written code
plain_request: I need a simple app to track my bakery's daily income and expenses and show me a chart of the month. Make it work nicely on my phone.
title: small-business budget tracker SPA
critical_rationale: The user asks for 'nice on my phone'; world-class delivery enforces Core Web Vitals bundle budgets + image/font optimization (web-vitals namespace) which a layperson cannot name.
acceptance_criteria: The owner can record an income or expense entry with an amount and category
The app shows a running monthly total and a chart of spending by category
Entered amounts are validated so a typo cannot corrupt the totals
First-load bundle stays within the route budget so the app opens fast on mobile
